slides.title: Merti, Oromia: local areas emptied of residents
Hundreds of families stranded
slides.body: Community representatives say 21 of 23 local kebeles are emptied; families lack steady aid.

slides.title: Displaced for up to 3 years
slides.body: Many rely on rented rooms or host families, residents report.

slides.title: Officials: aid not enough
slides.body: The woreda administrator says daily relief is active but insufficient.

slides.title: Protect civilians, open aid access
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
